build_SAConv2d_standard: build a SAConv2d layer with 256 in and out channels and kernel size 3 for object detection
build_SAConv2d_deformable: build a SAConv2d layer with use_deform True to enable deformable convolution for adaptive receptive fields
test_SAConv2d_forward: test the SAConv2d forward pass with a random tensor input and verify output shape
review_SAConv2d_init_weights: review the SAConv2d init_weights method to understand how switch and context modules are initialized
